prepared_by: independent test writer, round 3 (hand-verified with git)
notes: Round-3 held-out questions, written by hand with read-only git (git show/log/diff -M/tag --contains/merge-base --is-ancestor, plus ast parsing of `git show` output) AFTER round-2 results were seen (artifacts/repo_history_eval/20261018T050406Z.json; only failure categories were read); disjoint from every round-1 and round-2 question. No rw.repo output was consulted. Do not edit after any run. expected_facts follows the round-3 contract in tests/repo/test_s23_round3.py: changes facts list function/method qualnames only (classes under classes_*, deleted files under deleted_files, renames as {old,new,similarity}; symbols of a renamed file are matched by module-relative name; test files only in tests_changed, and only when indexed); constants carry is_plain_literal/evaluated; partially dotted names resolve on dotted-component suffixes; fix `state` is PRESENT when the fix commit is an ancestor and every non-blank added line is present. Names are matched as dotted suffixes of the full qualname.

questions.question: At v2.33.0, which exceptions does PreparedRequest.prepare_url raise?
At v2.33.0, which exceptions does BaseAdapter.send raise?
At v2.32.5, what is the value of utils.NETRC_FILES?
At v2.33.0, what is the value of adapters.DEFAULT_RETRIES?
At v2.33.0, what is the value of models.REDIRECT_STATI?
questions.expected_answer: A tuple of codes.* attributes (moved, found, other, temporary_redirect, permanent_redirect), src/requests/models.py lines 73-79; not a plain literal, not evaluated.

questions.question: At v2.32.5, what is the value of DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH?
questions.expected_answer: The call certs.where() (src/requests/utils.py line 64); not evaluated.

questions.question: What changed between v2.32.2 and v2.32.5?
questions.expected_answer: HTTPAdapter.build_connection_pool_key_attributes added; cert_verify, get_connection_with_tls_context, _urllib3_request_context, Response.json, Session.request, get_netrc_auth and super_len modified; nothing removed, deleted or renamed. Citations only at v2.32.2 or v2.32.5 (not v2.32.3/v2.32.4/v2.33.0).

questions.question: Is fix 47914226 (Fix empty netrc entry usage, #7205) present at v2.34.0?
questions.expected_answer: PRESENT: ancestor of v2.34.0 and its added line `if _netrc and any(_netrc):` is at src/requests/utils.py line 268 (the fix's test-file lines are outside the indexed scope; they are also present in git); first tag containing it is v2.33.0.

questions.question: Is fix 47914226 (Fix empty netrc entry usage, #7205) present at v2.32.5?
questions.expected_answer: ABSENT: not an ancestor and the line is not at v2.32.5; first tag containing it is v2.33.0.

questions.question: At v2.33.0, when did HTTPAdapter._get_connection appear and disappear?
questions.expected_answer: Present at v2.32.0 and v2.32.1 (src/requests/adapters.py line 377), gone from v2.32.2 (moved to get_connection_with_tls_context in aa1461b6); absent at v2.33.0.
